name: Rate together (one score or one word each, hidden till everyone's in)
use_when: the group judges one thing: a dating profile, a price, a dish, an outfit, a new place
'rate this out of 10', 'is this a fair price', 'everyone give a number', 'one word for him', 'what's it worth'
everyone answers on their own and sees the average and spread once all are in
dont_use_when: ranking options head to head (use bracket)
guarantees: one answer per person; scores are whole numbers on the scale
answers stay hidden behind faces until everyone in the chat is in, or someone who answered reveals with 2 or more in; they never hide again
the average is shown to one decimal, rounded half up in integer math, with the lowest and highest score
a leaver's answer goes; a late joiner can answer at once

title.description: The subject as a short question or name, e.g. 'Is $350 fair for the West Elm couch?'

low.description: Score mode: bottom of the scale, 0 or 1

high.description: Score mode: top of the scale, 3 to 10

lowLabel.description: What the low end means, e.g. 'ripoff', or ''

highLabel.description: What the high end means, e.g. 'steal', or ''
